interpretation.Q_difference: exact returned Q_A minus returned Q_B; no tolerance or float rounding
interpretation.coverage: original full graph and original largest-component supplement under the same original objective
interpretation.degree_nonaccepted: retained rejection/abstention/cap/zero-degree statuses; not all are mathematical rejections
interpretation.prefixes: correlated summaries of the same nine downstream calls, not independent replicates
interpretation.quality_matched: exact equal returned rational Q; its own n, null values when n=0
interpretation.replication: three fixed discovery seeds per graph/resolution; six observed graphs
interpretation.time_outcome_counts: three fixed seeds, classified by T_A/T_B relative to 1; undefined when T_B=0
interpretation.time_ratio_A_over_B: T_A/T_B; reciprocal of speedup when both costs are positive; null when T_B=0
